name: 68c128d8ffab
claim: Items queued on the plain portal port 8002 are remapped to TLS 8443 only when PEER_PORTAL_TLS_ENABLED=1 and the CA pin are set and --remap-port 8002:8443 maps the macOS portal port to 8443.

decisions.notes: flush-outbox with --remap-port 8002:8443 and correct TLS env passed verification; without the remap, port-8002 items target a non-TLS port.

rationale: Port remap is required to deliver items queued against the plain portal port over the TLS front end.
